findings.change: Explicit compact snapshots return complete state without the implicit delta branch. Action/wait deltas remain. No additional query, effect check, retry or CLI flag. Private Broker protocol 7 prevents reuse of the old output contract.
findings.exact_fixture_outcomes: All eight saved fixture outcomes passed. Eligible counts: cu 3 passed and 1 excluded; native 4 passed.
findings.excluded_attempt: triage-2-cu mistyped its shell configuration path, used the globally installed CLI, received observation_required on an untargeted click, and observed a non-fixture foreground app. Retained without replacement; not a valid timing pair.
findings.error_counter_limit: All outer tool error counters are zero. The excluded cu shell call contained a failing command followed by a successful snapshot and exited zero. This embedded error is preserved in its manual audit; zero outer errors is not zero command errors.
findings.strategy: All eligible cu trials used complete compact observations without ordinary JSON fallback. Native dataset 4 additionally read the general skill/git status metadata and requested full AX states with disableDiffing; all costs retained.
findings.interpretation: Payload fallback was removed, but consistent latency improvement is not established. Overall medians use different eligible datasets. Common datasets 3/4 worsened from a median ratio of 1.215 to 1.486. Dataset 4 retained a long non-tool interval despite shorter output.
findings.lifecycle: Fresh task/app/state for each attempt; alternating order; no overlap/coaching/replacement; fixed inputs throughout. All fixture apps and dedicated Brokers stopped only after completed/idle.

limits: Three eligible pairs of one custom AppKit task; not browser/Electron/commercial-app coverage.
Fresh state does not mean fresh OS/caches or identical backend load.
Non-tool intervals include model/network/scheduling time, not measured inference alone; backend tool instrumentation differs.
Model strategy varies, including native full-state choice and initialization reads; this is not a controlled causal before/after study.
One excluded cu attempt observed a non-fixture app; its private tool trace stays local and is not exported.
